title: CHCHD2 mitigates age-associated proteostatic collapse by maintaining homeostasis of the mitochondria-lysosome axis
title_zh: CHCHD2通过维持线粒体-溶酶体轴的稳态来减轻与年龄相关的蛋白质稳态崩溃
abstract: Abstract Mutations in coiled-coil-helix-coiled-coil-helix domain containing 2 (CHCHD2), including the Parkinson’s disease (PD)-linked CHCHD2 T61I mutation, are associated with Lewy body disorders (LBDs) by unknown mechanisms. Here, we demonstrate that CHCHD2 T61I exacerbates age-related brain pathologies, including axonal degeneration and cognitive deficits, by disrupting the mitochondria-lysosome axis. Specifically, CHCHD2 T61I binds and reduces cathepsin B (CTSB) and cathepsin L (CTSL) levels, inducing lysosomal membrane permeability and impairing α-synuclein fibril clearance. We also demonstrate that human CHCHD2 declines in the brain with age, while expression of wild-type CHCHD2 safeguards against age-related neuroinflammation, dopaminergic neuron loss, insoluble protein aggregation, and structural deterioration of mitochondria and lysosomes. These findings, supported by observed reductions in CTSB and CHCHD2 in human LBD brains, establish CHCHD2 as a key regulator of neuronal resilience to aging and proteostatic collapse via the mitochondria-lysosome axis. Preventing age-associated CHCHD2 decline offers a therapeutic strategy to preserve brain health throughout aging.
abstract_zh: 摘要：共轭螺旋-螺旋-共轭螺旋-螺旋结构域蛋白2（CHCHD2）的突变，包括与帕金森病（PD）相关的CHCHD2 T61I突变，已与路易体疾病（LBD）相关，但机制尚不清楚。我们证明，CHCHD2 T61I通过破坏线粒体-溶酶体轴，加剧了年龄相关的大脑病理，包括轴突退化和认知缺陷。具体而言，CHCHD2 T61I结合并降低了半胱氨酸蛋白酶B（CTSB）和半胱氨酸蛋白酶L（CTSL）的水平，导致溶酶体膜通透性增加，阻碍α-突触核蛋白纤维的清除。我们还发现，人类CHCHD2在大脑中随年龄下降，而野生型CHCHD2的表达可防止年龄相关的神经炎症、多巴胺能神经元丢失、不可溶蛋白聚集以及线粒体和溶酶体结构恶化。这些发现，结合在人类LBD大脑中观察到的CTSB和CHCHD2水平下降，确立了CHCHD2作为通过线粒体-溶酶体轴调节神经元对衰老和蛋白质稳态崩溃的关键调节因子。预防年龄相关的CHCHD2下降为在整个衰老过程中保持脑部健康提供了一种治疗策略。
